parameters.help_en: The ID of the job template that you want to delete
parameters.name: app_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The call was successful.

3xx: The call was redirected.

4xx: The call failed.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code that is returned. Take note of the following rules:

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

If the call fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the "Error codes" section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information that is returned. Valid values:

success: If the call is successful, success is returned.

An error code: If the call fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the application is deleted. Valid values:

true: The namespaces were obtained.

false: no
Success.description_zh:
删除任务模板是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：删除成功。
false：删除失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
